title: Add Dery AI to image
author: pollinations-ai[bot]
pr_body_excerpt:
- Adds [Dery AI](https://dery-ai.my.id) to image
- Create collaborative images using the Pollinations image API

Fixes #13782

gist.headline: A shared canvas blooms
gist.blurb: Dery AI joined the garden with a collaborative canvas powered by the Pollinations image API. More people can now pass pixels around and make something pleasantly strange together.
gist.summary: Added Dery AI to the app directory, giving users a collaborative image-making experience built on the Pollinations image API.
gist.impact: Users can discover and use Dery AI to create images together while Pollinations handles the generation layer.
gist.visual_concept: Depict a cozy shared pixel-art canvas where Polli and a few friendly collaborators add colorful image tiles to one large garden mural. The collaborative canvas represents Dery AI, while sprouting code-flowers and a glowing retro image terminal connect it clearly to the Pollinations image API.
gist.image_prompt: A cozy shared pixel-art art table where the main character is a cute pixel art bee mascot with a yellow body and dark brown horizontal stripes, small black legs, two black antennae, black vertical oval eyes, bright pink rectangular blush marks on cheeks, a small happy smile, and small rounded light blue translucent wings; she wears a tiny painter’s beret and happily places a pixel flower tile onto a collaborative canvas beside a glowing retro image terminal and code-plants. Cozy 8-bit pixel art aesthetic, soft lime green (#ecf874) and pastel gradient background, warm lighting, retro gaming vibes like Stardew Valley or A Short Hike, with simple pixel-font text: “CREATE TOGETHER”; nostalgic but beautiful, emotionally warm.
